description: Dream Trip Planner: estimates the total cost of a trip including airfare, accommodation, daily expenses, and optional travel insurance. Returns a cost breakdown (min/max/average due to insurance uncertainty) and a monthly savings plan for 12, 24, and 36 months. Use to help users plan their dream vacation budget and understand how much to save per month to reach their travel goal.

cotacaoBrl.description: Exchange rate to BRL at time of travel. Ex: 5.80 for USD/BRL. Required only if moedaDestino ≠ BRL. Informational for reference.

custoPassagemTotalCents.description: Total airfare/transport cost for all travelers in Brazilian cents (BRL). Ex: R$ 3,000 = 300000. Use 0 if traveling with miles.

gastoDiarioPorPessoaCents.description: Estimated daily expenses per person (food, local transport, attractions) in Brazilian cents. Ex: R$ 200/day = 20000.

hospedagemDiariaCents.description: Daily accommodation cost (total for all travelers, not per person) in Brazilian cents. Ex: R$ 500/day = 50000.

incluirSeguroViagem.description: If true, includes travel insurance estimate (3%–6% of airfare, minimum R$50–R$100 per person).

moedaDestino.description: Main currency of the destination. Use "BRL" for domestic trips. Informational only — costs must be entered in BRL cents.

tipoViagem.description: "nacional" = destination within Brazil, "internacional" = international destination (applies exchange rate if moedaDestino ≠ BRL)
